fact: In March 2023 the tax directorate was vectorising and georeferencing cadastral plans of seven Ouagadougou districts, reporting 434,274 parcels digitised in eCadastre at 31 December 2022 and a 2023 target of 500,000 parcels digitised and cadastral values assessed.
title: Informatisation du cadastre national : Les plans cadastraux de 07 arrondissements de Ouagadougou en cours de numérisation
